thread:
Alex: Quick sync — new on-call shadowing tonight. @Maya starts as a shadow at 22:00 PT. Can we confirm who’s primary/secondary for the rotation, and if there are any coverage gaps for EU overnight? Also want to run a paging test while Maya is shadowing so she sees the flow.

Oncall Bot: [oncall-bot] Heads up: scheduled paging test in 30m (ptest-2300501234). Will send call+sms to primary/secondary.

Sam: I can take primary 22:00-06:00 PT tonight. Jordan, can you be secondary 22:00-02:00? Lee can cover 02:00-06:00 correct?

Jordan: Yep, I’ll take secondary 22-02. Lee pls confirm.

Lee: Confirmed for 02-06. No PTO or blocks. Quick note: EU traffic spike last week was on the 02:30 window, so Sam + Lee heads-up.

Maya: Thanks — excited to shadow. Any pre-read or runbook I should skim before 22:00?

Sam: Short pre-read: read the oncall runbook section "Immediate triage" and the inference restart procedure. Quick links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-restart

Sam: Quick checklist for tonight (short):
- confirm pager contact info in profile
- open the runbook and read "Pager flow"
- watch a paging test and observe acknowledgement/notify steps

Alex: Putting the minimal triage steps here so Maya can follow during shadow:
```
1) Check the incident dashboard: /incidents -> see active SEVs
2) Confirm customer impact: look at metrics (latency, error-rate) and Slack #prod-alerts
3) If SEV1 (customer-facing outage): page SEV1 rota, run binary rollback or emergency restart per runbook
4) If SEV2 (degraded): open ticket, notify CS with template, consider scaling up dedicated pool for impacted tenant
```

Sam: Practical commands you might run while shadowing (you won't actually run them unless asked):
```bash
# view inference service pods
kubectl get pods -n inference | grep worker
# tail logs for a worker
kubectl logs -f worker-0 -n inference
# quick health check for API
curl -sS https://api.redwood.internal/v1/_health | jq .
```

Oncall Bot: [oncall-bot] Paging test starting now. Sending to Sam (call), Jordan (sms). Response window: 3m. test_id=ptest-2300501234

Sam: Got the call, acknowledging. :thumbsup:

Jordan: SMS received, acknowledged.

Maya: Watching — Sam, could you narrate your thought process when you get the page? I’ll take notes.

Sam: Sure — first: confirm whether this is a test or real alert (check test_id in bot). Next: open dashboard -> check latency/errors -> check recent deploys. If it's real and > SLO breach, escalate to SEV1 flow.

Alex: For escalation, remember the steps in runbook "Escalation & Communications": page eng-sre, then lead eng, and post status in #incidents with a short impact blurb and link to incident ticket. Use the customer notification template if customer-facing.

Maya: One question — how do we handle coverage gaps if someone needs to drop mid-shift?

Jordan: Short answer: find a swap on the rotation board (https://redwood.internal/rotations), if nobody available, escalate to ops-rotation to get a short-term backup. Update the handoff note in #oncall-handoffs immediately.

Sam: Also add your phone number to Profile -> Notifications and run the personal paging test from the console (Profile -> Test Notifications). If you can't receive SMS/calls, use PagerDuty mobile app fallback.

Maya: Phone is added. I’ll run the test at 21:50 during prep.

Alex: For the handoff record, please use this minimal template (paste into #oncall-handoffs or the rotation doc):
```
Handoff (start: 22:00 PT)
- active_incidents: none
- services_with_warnings: inference-cache (elevated errors last 24h)
- pager_status: primary(Sam): confirmed, secondary(Jordan): confirmed
- notes: watch EU 02:00 window; rolling restart script in runbook if spikes recur
```

Sam: I'll run a dry run of a mock mitigation at 23:15 with Maya watching — small restart of a non-critical worker to show the commands and dashboard checks.

Lee: FYI ops-rotation handed out the holiday swaps; no gaps tonight beyond the usual EU risk.

Oncall Bot: [oncall-bot] Paging test complete: Sam acknowledged (37s), Jordan acknowledged (92s). test_id=ptest-2300501234.

Alex: Great. Maya — meet Sam on Zoom at 21:55 for a 10m prep walkthrough, then join the shift channel at 22:00. Please leave any questions in this thread and we'll answer before the shadow starts.

Maya: Got it, see you at 21:55. Thanks everyone!

Sam: Thanks — looking forward to it. :rocket:
